# CalcThis

> CalcThis (calcthis.co) is a free collection of online calculators — construction, health & fitness, school grades, math, cooking and money & finance — each with live results, worked examples and plain-English explanations. No sign-up required; calculations run in the browser.

## Calculators
- [Board Foot Calculator — Instant BF & Lumber Cost](https://calcthis.co/board-foot-calculator/): Free board foot calculator. Enter thickness, width, and length to get board feet and cost instantly. Supports 4/4 quarter sizes, metric, and a running cut-list tally.
- [Gravel Calculator — How Much Gravel Do I Need? (Tons & Yards)](https://calcthis.co/gravel-calculator/): Free gravel calculator. Enter your area and depth to get how much gravel you need in tons, cubic yards, or bags — plus cost. Add multiple areas for a whole project. Rectangle or circle, US or metric.
- [Mulch Calculator — How Much Mulch Do I Need? (Yards & Bags)](https://calcthis.co/mulch-calculator/): Free mulch calculator. Enter your bed size and depth to get how much mulch you need in cubic yards or bags — plus cost. Add multiple beds for a whole project. Rectangle or circle, US or metric.
- [Concrete Bag Calculator — How Many Bags of Concrete in a Yard](https://calcthis.co/concrete-calculator/): Free concrete calculator. Enter your slab size and thickness to get how many 40, 60, or 80 lb bags you need — plus cubic yards, weight, and cost. Add multiple slabs for a whole project. Rectangle or circle, US or metric.
- [Sand Calculator — How Much Sand Do I Need? (Tons, Yards & Bags)](https://calcthis.co/sand-calculator/): Free sand calculator. Enter your area and depth to get how much sand you need in tons, cubic yards, or bags — plus cost. Paver bedding, leveling, play, and fill sand. Add multiple areas for a whole project. US or metric.
- [Topsoil Calculator — How Much Topsoil Do I Need? (Yards, Tons & Bags)](https://calcthis.co/topsoil-calculator/): Free topsoil calculator. Enter your area and depth to get how much topsoil you need in cubic yards, tons, or bags — plus cost. Also covers garden soil, fill dirt, and compost. Add multiple beds or areas for a whole project. US or metric.
- [Flooring Calculator — How Much Flooring Do I Need? (Boxes & Sq Ft)](https://calcthis.co/flooring-calculator/): Free flooring calculator. Enter your room size to get how many boxes of flooring you need — laminate, vinyl plank, hardwood or tile — plus square footage, waste and cost. Add multiple rooms for a whole project. US or metric.
- [Tape Measure Fraction Calculator — Add & Subtract Inch Fractions](https://calcthis.co/tape-measure-fraction-calculator/): Free tape measure fraction calculator. Add and subtract feet, inches and fractions from a running cut-list total, see the exact tick mark on a live tape-measure ruler, and multiply or divide a measurement into equal parts. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Tile Calculator — How Many Tiles Do I Need? (Tiles, Boxes & Cost)](https://calcthis.co/tile-calculator/): Free tile calculator. Enter your area and tile size to get exactly how many tiles you need — plus boxes, waste and cost. Works for floors, walls and backsplashes, ceramic to mosaic. Add multiple areas for a whole project. US or metric.
- [Paint Calculator — How Much Paint Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/paint-calculator/): Free paint calculator for interior and exterior walls, ceilings and trim. See a live room diagram, get a shopping list of exactly how many gallons and quarts to buy per surface, the leftover, the cost, and a project total across rooms.
- [Wallpaper Calculator — How Many Rolls Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/wallpaper-calculator/): Free wallpaper calculator that counts rolls the way paperhangers do — in whole strips, with pattern repeat and match type. See a live strip diagram of every wall, the leftover, the cost, and a project total across rooms.
- [Square Footage Calculator — Rooms, Circles, Triangles & More](https://calcthis.co/square-footage-calculator/): Free square footage calculator with 13 shapes — rectangle, circle, ring, triangle, trapezoid, wall minus window and more. Add multiple areas to a running project total, see a live diagram of your shape, and get an instant cost estimate.
- [Stair Calculator — Rise, Run, Stringer Length & Materials](https://calcthis.co/stair-calculator/): Free stair calculator: enter total rise and it works out riser height, tread run, number of steps, stringer length and angle. Live diagram, code & comfort checks, and a materials + cost estimate for stringers, treads and risers.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator — Boer, James & Hume Formulas](https://calcthis.co/lean-body-mass-calculator/): Free lean body mass calculator using the Boer, James and Hume formulas, with a live lean-vs-fat composition bar. Enter a known body fat % for an exact result, or estimate from height and weight alone. Includes the Peters formula for children.
- [Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator — Check Your WHR & Health Risk](https://calcthis.co/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator/): Free waist-to-hip ratio calculator. Enter your waist and hip measurements to get your WHR, see where it falls on a live sex-specific health-risk gauge, and get a WHO waist-circumference cross-check. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Pace Calculator — Running Pace, Time & Distance (with Splits)](https://calcthis.co/pace-calculator/): Free running pace calculator. Enter any two of pace, time and distance and get the third instantly — plus speed in km/h and mph, per-km or per-mile splits, and equivalent 5K, 10K, half and marathon finish times. km or miles.
- [Race Time Predictor — Riegel & VDOT Finish Times + Splits](https://calcthis.co/race-time-predictor/): Free race time predictor. Enter one recent race and get predicted finish times for the mile, 5K, 10K, half and marathon from two models side by side — Riegel and VDOT — plus your fitness score and target splits. Instant, no sign-up.
- [VO2 Max Calculator — Estimate Your Aerobic Fitness](https://calcthis.co/vo2-max-calculator/): Free VO2 max calculator. Estimate your aerobic fitness from resting heart rate or a 1-mile walk test, see where you rank against age-and-sex norms on a live percentile gauge, and get equivalent 5K, 10K, half and marathon race times. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Heart Rate Zone Calculator — Zone 2, Karvonen & Max HR](https://calcthis.co/heart-rate-zone-calculator/): Free heart rate zone calculator. Get your 5 training zones and Zone 2 fat-burn range from your age, plus personalised Karvonen zones from your resting heart rate. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Zone 2 Heart Rate Calculator](https://calcthis.co/zone-2-heart-rate-calculator/): Find your Zone 2 heart rate training range instantly. Enter your age, choose your MHR formula (Fox, Tanaka, or Gulati), and add your resting heart rate for personalised Karvonen results.
- [BMI Calculator — Body Mass Index for Men & Women](https://calcthis.co/bmi-calculator/): Free BMI calculator with a live BMI chart. Get your body mass index and weight category from height and weight, in metric or imperial, see your point on the height-weight map, and your healthy weight range. Advanced mode adds a target weight, BMI Prime and the Ponderal Index. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Calorie Calculator — How Many Calories to Lose Weight](https://calcthis.co/calorie-calculator/): Free calorie calculator. Enter your details and a goal weight to get your daily calorie target, a gentle/moderate/fast pace table with safety flags, a projected weight-loss curve with milestone dates, a goal date, and a protein target. Advanced mode plans by target date. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Body Fat Calculator — US Navy Body Fat % for Men & Women](https://calcthis.co/body-fat-calculator/): Free body fat percentage calculator using the US Navy tape method. Get your body fat % and category for men and women from a tape measure — no scale needed. Advanced mode adds a BMI cross-check plus fat and lean mass. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator — How Much Should I Weigh?](https://calcthis.co/ideal-weight-calculator/): Free ideal weight calculator. Get your healthy weight range for your height in kg or lb, see the Robinson, Devine, Miller and Hamwi formula estimates on one scale, adjust for body frame size, and check how far your current weight is from the range. Men and women, no sign-up.
- [TDEE Calculator — Daily Calorie & Maintenance Calories](https://calcthis.co/tdee-calculator/): Free TDEE calculator. Find your total daily energy expenditure and maintenance calories from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, plus calorie targets for losing or gaining weight. Advanced mode adds a Katch-McArdle estimate and a protein, carb and fat macro split. Instant, no sign-up.
- [One Rep Max Calculator — 1RM for Bench, Squat & Deadlift](https://calcthis.co/one-rep-max-calculator/): Free one rep max calculator. Estimate your 1RM for bench, squat, deadlift or any lift from the weight and reps of a working set, plus a full %-of-1RM training table. Advanced mode compares Epley, Brzycki and Lombardi. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Sleep Calculator — Best Bedtime & Wake-Up Time by Sleep Cycles](https://calcthis.co/sleep-calculator/): Free sleep calculator. Find the best time to go to bed or wake up using 90-minute sleep cycles, so you wake between cycles feeling rested. Works from your wake-up time or from when you fall asleep. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Water Intake Calculator — How Much Water Should You Drink a Day?](https://calcthis.co/water-intake-calculator/): Free water intake calculator. Get your personalised daily target from your weight, activity and climate — in glasses, litres and fl oz — plus a glass-by-glass schedule for the day. Adjusts for pregnancy and breastfeeding. No sign-up.
- [Final Grade Calculator — What Do I Need on My Final Exam?](https://calcthis.co/final-grade-calculator/): Find out exactly what score you need on your final exam to reach your target grade — or predict your course grade from an expected exam score. Instant, no sign-up.
- [GPA Calculator — College & High School (Weighted/Unweighted)](https://calcthis.co/gpa-calculator/): Free GPA calculator for college and high school. Supports weighted and unweighted GPA, AP/IB/Honors bumps, letter grades or percentages, and a live what-if course adder.
- [Grade Calculator — Weighted Categories for Any Course](https://calcthis.co/grade-calculator/): Free weighted grade calculator. Enter your syllabus categories (homework, quizzes, midterm, final), weights, and scores for an instant course grade. Supports % scores and points mode.
- [Test Score Calculator — Raw Score, Percentage & Letter Grade](https://calcthis.co/test-score-calculator/): Convert raw test scores to percentages and letter grades instantly. Find out how many questions you can miss, calculate curved grades, and estimate AP scores (1–5). Free, live, no sign-up.
- [Grade Curve Calculator — Live Before/After Distribution](https://calcthis.co/grade-curve-calculator/): Free grade curve calculator. Paste your class's raw scores, pick a curve method (add points, highest-to-100%, percentage boost, bell curve, square root and more), and see the new grade distribution instantly — before/after mean, median, and how many students land in each letter grade.
- [Fraction Calculator — Add, Subtract, Multiply & Divide With Visual Bars](https://calcthis.co/fraction-calculator/): Free fraction calculator. Add, subtract, multiply and divide any number of fractions, mixed numbers and decimals, simplify fractions, and convert decimals to fractions — with a live bar diagram and step-by-step working.
- [Standard Deviation Calculator — Sample & Population, With a Live Number Line](https://calcthis.co/standard-deviation-calculator/): Free standard deviation calculator. Paste your numbers and get the sample and population standard deviation side by side, plus mean, variance and step-by-step working — with a live number line showing the spread. Outliers, z-scores and confidence interval under Go advanced.
- [Scientific Notation Calculator — Convert & Calculate](https://calcthis.co/scientific-notation-calculator/): Free scientific notation calculator: convert any number to and from scientific notation, E-notation and engineering notation, or calculate with expressions like (3×10^4)(2×10^6). See the decimal point move, with exact results, SI prefixes and step-by-step working.
- [Weighted Average Calculator — Live Contribution Breakdown](https://calcthis.co/weighted-average-calculator/): Free weighted average calculator. Add any number of value + weight rows, see your weighted average update live, plus a contribution bar showing which entries pull it the most. Go advanced to solve for a missing value.
- [Ratio Calculator — Simplify, Solve & Scale Any Ratio](https://calcthis.co/ratio-calculator/): Free ratio calculator. Simplify ratios instantly, solve for a missing value, or scale any ratio up or down — with a live visual proportion bar and real-world presets.
- [Percentage Calculator — % of a Number, What %, % Change](https://calcthis.co/percentage-calculator/): Free percentage calculator — find % of a number, calculate what percent one number is of another, or find % change between two values. Live visual result, instant answers.
- [Age Calculator — How Old Am I? Exact Age from Date of Birth](https://calcthis.co/age-calculator/): Free age calculator. Enter your date of birth for your exact age in years, months and days, a live seconds count, totals in weeks and days, the weekday you were born, a next-birthday countdown and a life timeline. Advanced mode finds your age on any past or future date. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Date Calculator — Days Between Dates + Add or Subtract Days](https://calcthis.co/date-calculator/): Free date calculator. Get the number of days, weeks, months and years between two dates, or add and subtract days from a date. Business-days count, the weekday and day-of-year of each date, and a live span timeline. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Time Calculator — Elapsed Time, Add/Subtract & Time Card](https://calcthis.co/time-calculator/): Free time calculator. Find the elapsed time between two clock times, add or subtract hours minutes and seconds with a running total, or total your work hours with a time card — clock in/out, breaks, overtime and weekly pay. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Macro Calculator — Daily Protein, Carbs & Fat Goals](https://calcthis.co/macro-calculator/): Free macro calculator — get your daily protein, carbs and fat targets based on your goal. Live animated ring shows your macro split. Balanced, high-protein, keto and low-carb modes.
- [Peptide Reconstitution Calculator](https://calcthis.co/peptide-reconstitution-calculator/): Enter your vial size, BAC water volume, and target dose. Instantly see your U-100 syringe draw units on a visual syringe — plus concentration, doses per vial, and cycle planning for BPC-157, TB-500, and more.
- [Steps to Miles Calculator — Convert Steps to Distance](https://calcthis.co/steps-to-miles-calculator/): Free steps to miles calculator. Convert your step count to miles or km using your own height-based stride length, see it against real distance milestones on a live bar, and estimate calories burned by walking speed and incline. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Protein Intake Calculator — How Much Protein Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/protein-intake-calculator/): Free protein intake calculator. Get your daily protein target in grams for sedentary, general fitness, muscle gain or fat loss, see where it falls on a live g/kg gauge, and get real-world food equivalents. Instant, no sign-up.
- [Recipe Converter — Scale a Recipe & Convert Cups to Grams](https://calcthis.co/recipe-converter/): Free recipe converter: paste any ingredient list, scale it to the servings you need and get kitchen-ready amounts — cup and spoon fractions, whole eggs, cups to grams per ingredient, US or metric. Pan-size scaling, oven temperatures and cost under Go advanced.
- [Turkey Cooking Time Calculator — USDA Times by Weight](https://calcthis.co/turkey-cooking-time-calculator/): Free turkey cooking time calculator: USDA roasting times at 325 °F by weight, stuffed or unstuffed, whole turkey or breast, plus a dinner-time plan.
- [Turkey Thawing Time Calculator — Fridge & Cold Water](https://calcthis.co/turkey-thawing-time-calculator/): Free turkey thawing time calculator: refrigerator and cold-water thaw times by weight and the day and hour to start, worked back from dinner.
- [Turkey Size Calculator — How Big a Turkey Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/turkey-size-calculator/): Free turkey size calculator: adults, children and leftovers in, the turkey size to buy out, with the thaw and roast time for that size.
- [BMR Calculator — Basal Metabolic Rate, 5 Formulas](https://calcthis.co/bmr-calculator/): Free BMR calculator: your basal metabolic rate in kcal and kJ from five formulas on one scale, plus daily calories by activity level and lose, maintain and gain targets.
- [Hours Calculator — Hours Worked, Breaks & Overtime](https://calcthis.co/hours-calculator/): Free hours calculator: type the digits and get hours worked with breaks, split and overnight shifts, weekly overtime and pay, hours between dates and minutes to decimal hours.
- [Triangle Calculator — Solve Any Triangle, Right Triangle & Pythagorean Theorem](https://calcthis.co/triangle-calculator/): Free triangle calculator. Enter any 3 values (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, SSA) or any 2 for a right triangle and get every side, angle, area, perimeter and height — with a live to-scale diagram, the two-triangle ambiguous case and step-by-step working.
- [Mortgage Calculator — Monthly Payment, Extra Payments & Amortization](https://calcthis.co/mortgage-calculator/): Free mortgage calculator. Enter the home price, down payment, rate and term to get your monthly payment, a live balance chart, the month principal overtakes interest, what extra payments save, and 10/15/20/30-year terms side by side. Taxes, insurance and PMI under Go advanced.
- [Loan Calculator — Monthly Payment, True APR & Amortization](https://calcthis.co/loan-calculator/): Free loan calculator. Enter the amount, rate and term to get your payment, a live balance chart, the month principal overtakes interest and what extra payments save. Or flip to “What can I borrow?” to work backwards from a payment. Any payment frequency, compounding and the true APR with a fee under Go advanced.
- [Auto Loan Calculator — Car Payment, Trade-In & Sales Tax](https://calcthis.co/auto-loan-calculator/): Free auto loan calculator. Enter the car price, down payment, trade-in, sales tax and fees to get your monthly payment, what you pay at signing and the total cost. Flags negative equity on your trade-in, or flip to “Max car price” to work backwards from a monthly payment.
- [Tip Calculator — Split the Bill, Tip on Tax or Total](https://calcthis.co/tip-calculator/): Free tip calculator. Enter the bill, pick a tip percentage and see the tip, the total and each person’s share; tip before or after tax, round up, split evenly or by what each person ordered, or work out what percent you tipped.
- [How Much to Tip: Tip Guide by Service + Calculator](https://calcthis.co/how-much-to-tip/): typical tips for restaurants, hairdressers, barbers, tattoo artists, massage therapists, dog groomers, Uber drivers, movers and valets, with the sources and a calculator. Each service has its own page under /how-much-to-tip/.
- [Tipping in Canada](https://calcthis.co/tipping-in/canada/), [Tipping in Italy](https://calcthis.co/tipping-in/italy/) and [Tipping in Japan](https://calcthis.co/tipping-in/japan/): how tipping works in each country, with the sources, a Canadian tip calculator that splits out provincial tax, an Italian restaurant-bill tool (coperto and servizio) and the Japanese guidance that tipping is not expected.

## Guides (blog)
- [How to Calculate Stair Rise and Run (Plus Stringer Length)](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-stair-rise-and-run/): The riser-height formula, standard vs. flush stringer mounts, the Pythagorean stringer-length formula, and the IRC building-code numbers every staircase has to meet — with a full worked example.
- [What Is Lean Body Mass? How to Calculate and Track It](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-lean-body-mass/): What lean body mass actually measures, the exact formula if you know your body fat %, the Boer/James/Hume estimate formulas if you don't, and what counts as a healthy range — with a full worked example.
- [What Is a Weighted Average? How to Calculate It (With Examples)](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-a-weighted-average/): What a weighted average is, the formula, a full worked example with exam grades, what to use as a weight, and how it differs from a simple average — with real-world uses beyond school.
- [How to Curve Grades: Every Method Explained](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-curve-grades/): Six ways to curve grades — add points, scale to the highest score, percentage boost, bell curve, square root, and target-mean — with the formula for each, a worked example, and which one to actually use.
- [What Is Waist-to-Hip Ratio? How to Measure and Interpret Your WHR](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-waist-to-hip-ratio/): What waist-to-hip ratio measures, exactly how to measure your waist and hips, the WHO risk bands by sex, a full worked example, and how WHR compares to BMI and waist circumference alone.
- [How Much Protein Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-protein-do-i-need/): How much protein you actually need by goal, why the RDA is a floor not a target, how age and sex change the number, total weight vs. lean body mass, and how to spread it across meals.
- [How to Calculate Square Footage (Any Shape, Room, or Project)](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-square-footage/): The exact formulas for calculating square footage — rectangles, circles, triangles, trapezoids and irregular rooms — plus how to convert to square yards and acres, and how much extra to order for waste.
- [CalcThis Blog — Calculators Explained](https://calcthis.co/blog/): CalcThis Blog — clear guides that explain what the calculators are doing and why the numbers matter. Construction, gardening, health, and more.
- [How Much Gravel Do I Need for a Driveway?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-gravel-do-i-need-for-a-driveway/): The exact formula for calculating driveway gravel — plus depth guide, material comparison, cost estimates, and a pro checklist before you order.
- [How Much Mulch Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-mulch-do-i-need/): The exact formula for calculating mulch for garden beds — coverage guide, mulch type comparison, depth recommendations, and a checklist before you order.
- [How Much Topsoil Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-topsoil-do-i-need/): The exact formula for calculating topsoil for lawns and garden beds — depth guide, coverage per cubic yard, topsoil types, and a checklist before you order.
- [How Much Concrete Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-concrete-do-i-need/): The formula for calculating concrete by cubic yards or bags — plus thickness guide, bags vs. ready-mix breakdown, PSI guide, and a pre-pour checklist.
- [How Much Sand Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-sand-do-i-need/): How to calculate exactly how much sand you need — with depth guide by project type, sand types explained, bags vs. bulk comparison, and the compaction factor most people miss.
- [How to Calculate Your Macros](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-your-macros/): How to calculate your macros in four steps — find your TDEE, set your goal, hit your protein target, then divide fat and carbs. Includes example, macro split table, and free calculator.
- [What Is Zone 2 Heart Rate? How to Calculate It](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-zone-2-heart-rate/): Zone 2 heart rate is 60–70% of your maximum heart rate — the training zone that builds aerobic base and fat-burning efficiency. Learn to calculate your exact range by age and how long to train in it.
- [What Is One Rep Max? How to Calculate Your 1RM](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-one-rep-max/): Your one-rep max (1RM) is the maximum weight you can lift for a single rep. Learn the Epley and Brzycki formulas, how to estimate it safely from a submaximal set, and how to use percentages to program your training.
- [How to Calculate Your TDEE](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-your-tdee/): Learn how to calculate your TDEE step by step: estimate your BMR with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, apply the right activity multiplier, and turn the number into a plan for losing, maintaining, or gaining weight.
- [How Much Flooring Do I Need?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-flooring-do-i-need/): Work out exactly how much flooring you need — square footage, the right waste factor for your material and layout, boxes to buy, and a real cost estimate.
- [How to Calculate Your Body Fat Percentage](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-your-body-fat-percentage/): Learn how to calculate your body fat percentage using the US Navy tape method, how it compares to BMI, what healthy ranges look like by age and sex, and how calipers, DEXA, and tape measure methods stack up on accuracy.
- [What Is BMI? How to Calculate and Interpret Your Body Mass Index](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-bmi/): What BMI is, the formula in metric and imperial, a worked example, the WHO weight categories, how to read your number into a healthy weight range, and where BMI falls short.
- [How Many Calories Should I Eat to Lose Weight?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-many-calories-to-lose-weight/): How to work out your calorie target for weight loss: find your maintenance calories, subtract a safe deficit, respect the minimum floors, and adjust as the scale moves. With a worked example.
- [How to Calculate Your Exact Age](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-your-exact-age/): How to work out your exact age in years, months, and days by hand: the borrow-and-subtract method, a worked example, age in total days, and the leap-year edge cases that trip people up.
- [How Much Should I Weigh? Healthy Weight by Height](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-much-should-i-weigh/): How much you should weigh isn't one number — it's a range. Here's how to find your healthy weight range from your height, what the Robinson, Devine, Miller and Hamwi formulas add, and where to aim inside the range.
- [How to Calculate the Number of Days Between Two Dates](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-calculate-the-number-of-days-between-two-dates/): How to count the days between two dates by hand: the day-number method, the count-forward method, whether to include the end date, weeks and months, business days, and the leap-year traps that make two calculators disagree.
- [How to Add and Subtract Fractions on a Tape Measure](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-to-add-fractions-on-a-tape-measure/): How to read the fraction marks on a tape measure and add or subtract measurements by hand: common denominators, borrowing an inch, converting to decimal and millimetres, and splitting a board into equal parts.
- [What Is VO2 Max? How to Estimate Your Aerobic Fitness](https://calcthis.co/blog/what-is-vo2-max/): What VO2 max measures, how to estimate it at home from your resting heart rate or a 1-mile walk test, what counts as a good number for your age and sex, and how it connects to your race pace.
- [How Many Steps Are in a Mile?](https://calcthis.co/blog/how-many-steps-are-in-a-mile/): The real answer isn't a flat 2,000 steps — stride length depends on your height. How to work out your own steps-per-mile, a height-based reference table, and what common step counts add up to in miles and km.

## About
- [CalcThis — Fast, Purpose-Built Calculators](https://calcthis.co/): CalcThis is a growing hub of fast, single-purpose calculators — construction, health & fitness, and school & grades. Free, instant, no sign-up.
- [About](https://calcthis.co/about/): CalcThis is a free collection of purpose-built calculators for construction, health, and school. No sign-up, no ads mixed into results — just fast, accurate answers.
